description_en: Queries the number of queries per second (QPS) that are sent to the origin server. You can query data collected in the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainSrcQpsData查询回源QPS数据，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDomainSrcQpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries QPS data for all accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
查询的加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you leave this parameter empty, data collected in the last 24 hours is queried
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time interval between the data entries. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried
